'''The Lost''' were [[Species/Legends|creatures]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. They were the result of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], indigenous [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropods]], who were unable to escape the destruction of the planet caused by the [[Hutt Cataclysms]], a civil war<ref name="LoNH" /> that ended in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Trapped in slums under the planet's surface, the lesser Hutts were cut off from the evacuation routes. Over the following [[Millennium/Legends|millenia]], they devolved into the creatures known as the Lost, surviving within underground pockets of air.<ref name="LoNH" /> By around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">According to ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'' the aftermath of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forcing the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] off of [[Lirra]] is a current event. Since ''Lords of Nal Hutta'' establishes Empire's actions on Lirra to have taken place in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the information must be relevant to sometime during or shortly after 2 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]].</ref> the Lost were [[albino/Legends|albino]] and feral, and had [[Claw/Legends|claws]] and a [[Disease/Legends|diseased]] bite. Though they were no longer of rational mind, they were cunning [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] that used their cleverness to prey on the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] working on Varl.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lost were mentioned in the [[2015]] sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a supplement for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] series. They are provided as a possible enemy for players to encounter on Varl.<ref name="LoNH" />
